memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "But God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us." — Romans 5:8

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
In our modern world, crossing a busy intersection without a designated path is a gamble with one's life. We look for the green signal, the painted stripes, or the hand of a traffic officer to ensure our passage. These are our "safe zones." Without them, we are exposed to the full force of oncoming traffic.
​Spiritually, the world is a chaotic highway of sin, distraction, and condemnation. Many attempt to cross this life on their own strength, ignoring the signals, only to find themselves overwhelmed. However, God has provided a singular, eternal Safe Zone: The Cross. 
Look at the Cross; it is the Highway for a sinner. The One who was already nailed, died, and has risen for you is standing nearby the Cross with His open, outstretched hands of love. Do not be distracted by Satan’s other paths that lead you astray. Jesus is the only way to eternity.
When we stand "Across the Cross," we are moving from the side of condemnation to the side of grace. Jesus took the full impact of our transgressions so that we could walk freely. Just as a pedestrian is protected by the law within a crossing, we are protected by His blood. Outside of this divine provision, there is no guarantee of safety; but within His sacrifice, our peace is guaranteed.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "The Cross was the lightning conductor of God’s justice, drawing the fire of judgment away from us and onto Christ." — by Unknown

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, I thank You for providing a way when there seemed to be no way. Thank You for the Cross of Jesus, which stands as my eternal safety zone. Forgive me for the times I have tried to navigate the dangers of life on my own. Today, I choose to stand under the shadow of the Cross, trusting in the freedom and safety that only Jesus provides. Guide my steps as I cross through this day. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Do not try to dodge the "traffic" of life’s worries today by your own skill. Look to the Cross. It is the only place where your past is forgiven, your present is secure, and your future is guaranteed. Walk boldly in His grace!
